whatItDoes: LLM Wiki Capture turns explicitly requested conversation material into a durable source packet and routes it through the Denote LLM Wiki ingest command.
It keeps source provenance available to later wiki checks and reports created or updated paths after ingestion.

whenToReachForIt.invocation: Explicitly ask the model to save, capture, ingest, remember, or structure material in your Denote LLM Wiki.

situations.when: A useful explanation from the current conversation should become durable reference material
situations.use: Capture the selected explanation without inventing missing facts.

situations.when: A new client, project, or topic needs a top-level wiki structure
situations.use: Describe the desired topology in the source packet before ingestion.

situations.when: New facts belong beneath a known note
situations.use: Include the parent title, identifier, or sequence so ingestion can update the existing structure.

whatItAdds: A bundled helper for packet creation, ingestion options, and optional linting.
Privacy and persistence checks before material enters the wiki.

questions.question: Does the skill edit wiki-maintained files directly?
answer: No. Its normal write path is the Denote LLM Wiki ingest command; direct edits are reserved for debugging the repository.

questions.question: What should be reviewed before capture?
answer: Secrets, credentials, private client information, and sensitive personal data need explicit review because source packets and wiki notes persist on disk.

workingIf: The capture source survives outside temporary storage and preserves relevant facts, URLs, caveats, and uncertainty.
Ingestion reports created or updated note paths and any remaining work.
A lint pass can trace notes back to source material without missing-on-disk errors.
setupNotes: Install the Git package so Agent Skills can discover the bundled LLM Wiki Capture skill.
Install and configure the Denote command-line interface, an LLM Wiki silo, and the selected model provider before ingestion.
Choose a persistent source directory and review sensitive material before writing the packet.
The repository is GPL-3.0-only; behavior claims were reviewed at the pinned installed revision.
